description: This file defines the ShellConfiguration class, which manages tenant-specific configuration data in the OrchardCore framework. It handles lazy initialization, updating, and disposal of configuration objects, integrating with external configuration sources.

classes.name: ShellConfiguration
classes.description: Manages tenant configuration with lazy loading, updating, and disposal capabilities.

methods.name: ShellConfiguration
methods.description: Constructors for initializing ShellConfiguration with various sources.

methods.name: EnsureConfiguration
methods.description: Ensures the configuration is initialized synchronously.

methods.name: EnsureConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the configuration if not already initialized.

methods.name: GetSection
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration section by key.

methods.name: GetReloadToken
methods.description: Gets a token that signals configuration reloads.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Disposes of configuration resources and semaphore.
